verses.text: For the one directing. With stringed instruments. A Maskil of David. Turn your ear, O God, to my prayer, and do not hide Yourself from my supplication.

verses.text: Be attentive to me, and answer me; [for] I am restless in my complaint, and make a noise,

verses.text: from the voice of the enemy, from the face of the oppression of the wicked. For they bring down trouble upon me, and in anger they hate me.

verses.text: behold, I would go far off wandering [and] would lodge in the wilderness. Selah

segments.text: behold, I would go far off wandering [and] would lodge in the wilderness. Selah

verses.text: I would hurry to shelter for myself, from the rushing wind, from the tempest.”

verses.text: Swallow up, O Lord, divide their tongues! For I have seen violence and strife in the city.

verses.text: Day and night they go around it, on its walls, and iniquity and trouble [are] within it.

verses.text: Disasters [are] within it, and oppression and deceit do not depart from its streets.

verses.text: For [it is] not an enemy [who] scorns me, or I could bear it; and not one hating me [who] wielded power against me, or I could hide myself from him.

verses.text: Devastation [is] upon them! May they go down alive [to] Sheol! For evils [are] in their dwellings, within them.

verses.text: I will call to God, and YHWH will save me.

segments.text: I will call to God, and YHWH will save me.

verses.text: In peace He has redeemed my soul from the battle against me, though there were many against me.

verses.text: God will hear and afflict them—even He who sits of old—Selah with whom there are no changes for Him. And they have not fear God.

verses.text: Cast your burden upon YHWH, and He will sustain you; He will not give a righteous one to be shaken forever.

verses.text: And You, O God, will bring them down to the Pit of destruction, men of blood and deceit! They will not live even half their days. And I will trust in You.
